Settings.OnRestHint: After PF2e's Rest for the Night, post a check card for the characters who rested.
Settings.SkillHint: Default: survival. Any other skill slug works too (perception …).
Settings.DcModeHint: Level-based DC (GM Core) or a fixed number.
Settings.WeightsHint: In order: common, uncommon, rare, epic, legendary. Default 70,18,8,3.5,0.5 (needn't add up to 100; used as ratios).
Settings.CostHint: Write it with units: '1 sp', '2 gp 5 sp', '1.5 gp' (a bare number is cp). When scaling by level, this is the level-1 cost (1 sp → 1 gp at level 10).
Settings.MaxHint: Not counting the free first spin. A critical success adds one free spin.
Settings.CashHint: Coins received instead of the item = its value × this rate. 0 hides the button.
Settings.BroadcastHint: When someone spins, the same wheel spins on everyone's screen (one at a time, with the character's portrait and name).
Settings.CostModeHint: Coins matter less at higher levels, so by default the cost scales with level.
Settings.CostTableHint: 'level: amount' pairs, comma-separated (e.g. 1: 1 sp, 5: 5 sp, 10: 1 gp). Each amount applies from that level up.
Settings.KeepHint: 'Pick': choose any one of the pulls. 'Last only': a re-spin discards earlier results and only the newest pull can be taken (real gacha tension).
Settings.MachineHint: The machine shown on the card after resting. 'Player's choice': each player picks on the card (when the GM offers a chance with the toolbar button, it's chosen then).
Settings.SkillOtherHint: A skill slug (thievery, perception, deception, society …). The roulette uses 'Check skill' above.
Settings.SlotRateHint: The roulette's re-spin cost × this (default 0.5 — cheap, many tries).
Settings.SlotMaxHint: How many paid re-spins are allowed (default 5).
Settings.HlRateHint: Each guess costs the roulette's re-spin cost × this. 0 (default): free — risking the pot is the price.
Settings.HlTieHint: When the next card has the same rank.
Settings.QueueHint: When several players have a chance at once, they queue up; when the current player takes their find or closes the window, the next player's window opens. Requires a GM online.
Settings.TurnTimeoutHint: If the current player doesn't spin within this time, the turn passes to the next player (they keep their chance). Disconnected players are skipped too.
Settings.HlRungsHint: Correct guesses in a row needed to raise the pot one tier (default 2 — eight in a row from common to legendary).
Settings.AfterCombatHint: When combat ends, the player characters who took part get a 'Battle loot' chance card. (After a night's rest it's 'Camp forage'.)

Slot.Hint: Pull the lever, then stop the reels yourself with STOP (Space: next reel). They stop on their own if you wait.

HL.Hint: Draw a card to reveal your first pot (an item). Each correct guess on whether the next card is higher or lower moves you up a rung; every two rungs the pot becomes an item one tier higher. One wrong guess and the pot is lost, leaving only a consolation snack — knowing when to stop is the whole game.
HL.CritBonus: Critical success: insurance — one wrong guess won't cost you the pot 🛡
HL.BustLine: {name} went empty-handed on guess {n} at High & Low.
HL.WonLine: {name} stopped at rung {n} of High & Low and took the pot
HL.Rules: A real 52-card deck · ace low, king high · drawn cards don't return · same rank: the house wins · red/black all-in: two rungs
HL.AllInHint: Guess just the color of the next card to climb two rungs at once. A wrong guess still loses the pot.
HL.Pot: The pot (stop now and it's yours)
HL.ConsolationLine: {name} climbed to rung {rung} at High & Low and lost the pot — only a consolation prize remains.
